projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: The Producer Portal was deployed to Production using a big-bang rollout approach to onboard 2,500+ producers on 22-Oct-2026, and ALT lists this as a WATCHLIST escalation trigger.
riskDescription.condition: If issues are encountered during mass producer onboarding, the rollout may need to be rolled back and remediated, disrupting the production environment.
riskDescription.consequence: Rollback could delay go-live, damage client trust, require emergency remediation effort, and impact producer access to critical business functions.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement phased rollout with pilot cohorts, daily monitoring dashboards, and automated rollback scripts to prevent mass onboarding failures.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detection of critical onboarding failure affecting 5% of users, activate automated rollback to last stable release and escalate to project board within 2 hours.
risks.reasoning: ALT WATCHLIST status as of 23-Oct-2026 identifies rollout risk; big-bang approach with 2,500+ users poses higher failure impact than phased rollout. End-to-end testing with 11 users completed successfully (ALT), but production scale risk remains. Project end date: 31-Dec-2026.

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed approximately 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort, and EMS R857 (Identified, Moderate/Medium) flags further scope additions as a risk.
riskDescription.condition: Additional scope changes may continue to emerge, particularly around the Dual Role requirement still under discussion as of 22-Jul-2026.
riskDescription.consequence: Further scope creep could erode the fixed-price contract margin, delay remaining deliverables, or require renegotiation with the client.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal change control board with weekly scope review meetings and mandatory client sign-off before accepting new requirements.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When cumulative scope changes exceed 1.5 sprint effort, initiate formal CR process with commercial re-baselining and communicate timeline impact to client.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk R857 (Identified, raised 29-Jun-2026); 14 scope changes already absorbed within $650K fixed-price contract (Project Artifacts); Dual Role requirement discussions ongoing (WSR 22-Jul-2026 Decision #37 Pending). Project end date: 31-Dec-2026.

riskDescription.context: Security scans detected 86 CVEs (4 Critical, 82 High) as of 22-Jul-2026, and remediation is marked as In-Progress in the Project Artifacts.
riskDescription.condition: If critical and high-severity vulnerabilities are not fully remediated before production stabilization, the application may remain exposed to security exploits.
riskDescription.consequence: Unpatched vulnerabilities could lead to security incidents, compliance audit failures, client penalties, or forced production downtime for emergency patching.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct weekly security scan reviews, prioritize Critical CVEs for immediate patching, and integrate automated vulnerability tracking into CI/CD pipeline.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Critical CVE remains unpatched 7 days before hypercare end, deploy compensating controls, notify CISO, and schedule emergency patching window with client approval.
risks.reasoning: 86 CVEs (4 Critical, 82 High) flagged in WSR 22-Jul-2026 demo deck slide 5; application already deployed to Production as of 23-Oct-2026 (ALT); remediation status not confirmed in ALT. Project end date: 31-Dec-2026.

riskDescription.context: Backend code coverage is 57% as of 22-Jul-2026 (WSR demo deck slide 5), and the project absorbed scope changes requiring data stitching and orchestration (WSR Scope Change #13, #15) with potential NFR impact.
riskDescription.condition: Low backend code coverage combined with complex data orchestration logic may allow defects to escape into production, especially under load.
riskDescription.consequence: Production defects could degrade user experience, trigger rollback, increase post-deployment support costs, and damage client confidence.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Increase backend code coverage to 75% by adding unit tests for orchestration logic and enforce coverage gates in Jenkins pipeline.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When production defect rate exceeds 3 critical defects per week during hypercare, activate war room with daily triage and deploy hotfixes within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Backend code coverage at 57% (WSR 22-Jul-2026); multiple scope changes involving Data Hub API orchestration and entity stitching (Project Artifacts); application deployed to Production (ALT 23-Oct-2026). Project end date: 31-Dec-2026.

riskDescription.context: Citrix server slowness and frequent disconnections are impacting offshore team efforts, flagged in WSR 22-Jul-2026 Challenge slide 2 and EMS go-green plan.
riskDescription.condition: If Citrix connectivity issues persist during Hypercare (Sep-Oct 2026), the offshore team may be unable to respond quickly to production incidents.
riskDescription.consequence: Delayed incident response could extend production outages, increase client dissatisfaction, and escalate support costs.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Escalate Citrix issue to Premera infrastructure team, implement VDI monitoring alerts, and provide backup onshore coverage during offshore hours.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Citrix downtime exceeds 2 hours during hypercare, activate onshore backup team for incident response and notify client of potential SLA impact.
risks.reasoning: Citrix slowness flagged in WSR 22-Jul-2026 and EMS go-green plan; ticket to be raised with Premera (EMS); Hypercare period Sep-Oct 2026 (Project Artifacts); offshore team dependency for support. Project end date: 31-Dec-2026.

riskDescription.context: The project uses AAVA agent framework with a term-based license limited to the Work Assignment duration (01-Mar-2026 to 31-Aug-2026), and multiple agent-related risks are open in WSR 22-Jul-2026 Risk Register (single LLM, tools integration delays, agent hardening, orchestration).
riskDescription.condition: If AAVA agents underperform or require manual fallback during Hypercare, productivity gains may not materialize and support effort may increase.
riskDescription.consequence: Manual effort fallback could erode margin, delay issue resolution, and reduce the business case for AAVA adoption in future phases.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Document AAVA agent limitations, implement manual workflow fallback procedures, and conduct agent performance validation before hypercare with senior developer review checkpoints.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When AAVA agent failure rate exceeds 20% during hypercare, switch to manual workflow and allocate additional developer capacity for issue resolution.
risks.reasoning: Multiple open AAVA agent risks in WSR 22-Jul-2026 Risk Register (single LLM, tools integration, agent hardening, orchestration); AAVA license term-limited to Work Assignment duration (Project Artifacts); Hypercare Sep-Oct 2026. Project end date: 31-Dec-2026.

riskDescription.context: Data mapping discussions were ongoing as of 22-Jul-2026, with WSR Risk Register flagging that if issues with data values lead back to design (entity stitching), there may be time impact (ETA 15-Jul-2026).
riskDescription.condition: If Data Hub data quality or mapping issues surface during production onboarding or Hypercare, defects may require design changes and rework.
riskDescription.consequence: Late design changes could delay stabilization, increase rework costs, and impact producer user experience during onboarding.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct weekly data mapping validation meetings with Data Hub and business teams, implement automated data quality checks, and validate all entity stitching logic before hypercare.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If data mapping defects impact 10% of producer records during onboarding, activate data remediation task force and communicate corrected data delivery timeline to client.
risks.reasoning: Data mapping risk flagged in WSR 22-Jul-2026 Risk Register (raised 25-Jun-2026, ETA 15-Jul-2026); entity stitching complexity noted in Scope Changes #13, #15 (Project Artifacts); production deployment completed (ALT 23-Oct-2026). Project end date: 31-Dec-2026.

riskDescription.context: The project absorbed 14 scope changes (0.75–1 sprint effort) within a $650K fixed-price contract, and no formal change orders have been raised as of 22-Jul-2026 (Project Artifacts).
riskDescription.condition: If additional scope, rework, or extended Hypercare support is required beyond the original SOW end date (31-Aug-2026), effort may exceed the contracted budget.
riskDescription.consequence: Budget overrun could erode margin, require internal cost absorption, or lead to commercial disputes with the client.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement formal change request process with mandatory commercial impact assessment and client sign-off before accepting any new scope beyond 14 absorbed changes.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When project budget utilization exceeds 90%, escalate to commercial leadership, freeze new scope acceptance, and initiate formal CR negotiation with client for additional funding.
risks.reasoning: 14 scope changes absorbed without change orders (Project Artifacts); fixed-price contract $650K (Work Assignment); project end date extended to 31-Dec-2026 from SOW end 31-Aug-2026 (EMS, Project Artifacts). Project end date: 31-Dec-2026.

riskDescription.context: The project is on ALT WATCHLIST as of 23-Oct-2026 due to big-bang rollout risk, and WSR 22-Jul-2026 flagged support required for upstream Data Hub data setup and UAT test cases.
riskDescription.condition: If the big-bang rollout encounters issues or if Hypercare support is insufficient, producer users may experience service disruptions or onboarding delays.
riskDescription.consequence: Poor producer experience during onboarding could damage Premera's relationship with producers, reduce portal adoption, and escalate client dissatisfaction.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish daily hypercare monitoring dashboards, conduct proactive user outreach for onboarding support, and maintain 24/7 incident response coverage during first 30 days post-rollout.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detection of user satisfaction score below 70% or 10+ critical support tickets per day, activate escalation to client leadership and deploy additional support resources within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: ALT WATCHLIST status (23-Oct-2026); big-bang rollout to 2,500+ producers on 22-Oct-2026 (ALT); support required for upstream data setup and UAT test cases (WSR 22-Jul-2026). Project end date: 31-Dec-2026.
